name: woocommerce/product-update
label: Update product
description: Update an existing product using supported catalog fields.

type.description: Product type, from the product types that WooCommerce and extensions register. Fields each type takes. simple: name, sku, description, short_description, status, virtual, downloadable, regular_price, sale_price, manage_stock, stock_quantity, stock_status; grouped: name, sku, description, short_description, status, grouped_products; external: name, sku, description, short_description, status, regular_price, sale_price, external_url, button_text; variable: name, sku, description, short_description, status, attributes, variations; variation: sku, description, status, virtual, downloadable, regular_price, sale_price, manage_stock, stock_quantity, stock_status.

name.description: Required, except on a variation, which takes its name from its parent. Applies to: simple, grouped, external, variable.

attributes.description: Attributes of the product, such as Size with the options S, M and L. Each variation picks one option of every attribute that is for variations. A name is an attribute of this product only, unless global is true or an id names a global attribute. The options of a global attribute are term names or slugs, and missing terms are created. Applies to: variable.

id.description: ID of a global attribute. 0 or absent for an attribute of this product only.

global.description: Use the global attribute with this name. The input is refused when there is none. Defaults to false.

visible.description: Whether the attribute shows on the product page. Defaults to true.

variation.description: Whether the variations pick an option of this attribute. Defaults to true. An attribute that is not for variations only shows on the product page.

variations.description: Variations to create, change or delete. An item with an id changes or deletes that variation, an item without one creates a variation. Other variations stay as they are. Applies to: variable.

id.description: ID of the variation to change. Leave it out to create a variation.

delete.description: Delete the variation with this id.

attributes.description: The option this variation picks for each attribute of its parent, by attribute name or global attribute id. For a global attribute the option is the term slug. An attribute with no option matches any option of the attribute.

id.description: ID of a global attribute. 0 or absent for an attribute of this product only.

regular_price.description: Decimal price as a string, without a currency symbol or thousand separators.

sale_price.description: Decimal price as a string, without a currency symbol or thousand separators.

description.description: Product description content. Safe HTML is allowed.

virtual.description: Whether the product is not shipped.

downloadable.description: Whether the product gives the customer files to download.

stock_quantity.description: Available stock quantity when product-level stock management is used.

regular_price.description: Decimal price as a string, without a currency symbol or thousand separators. Applies to: simple, external, variation.

sale_price.description: Decimal price as a string, without a currency symbol or thousand separators. Applies to: simple, external, variation.

description.description: Product description content. Safe HTML is allowed.

short_description.description: Short product description content. Safe HTML is allowed. Applies to: simple, grouped, external, variable.

virtual.description: Whether the product is not shipped. Applies to: simple, variation.

downloadable.description: Whether the product gives the customer files to download. Applies to: simple, variation.

stock_quantity.description: Available stock quantity when product-level stock management is used. Applies to: simple, variation.

external_url.description: External destination URL for external products. Applies to: external.

button_text.description: Button text for external products. Applies to: external.

grouped_products.description: Product IDs to include as children of a grouped product. Applies to: grouped.

permalink.description: Product permalink. Omitted when no public permalink is available.

type.description: Internal product type slug, such as simple, external, grouped, variable or variation.

price.description: Decimal price as a string, without a currency symbol.

regular_price.description: Decimal price as a string, without a currency symbol.

sale_price.description: Decimal price as a string, without a currency symbol.

on_sale.description: Whether the sale price applies now, taking the sale dates into account.

stock_quantity.description: Current stock quantity. Omitted when no stock quantity is set.

external_url.description: External product URL. Omitted when the product is not external or no URL is set.

button_text.description: Button text. Omitted when the product is not external or no button text is set.

grouped_products.description: Product IDs included as children of a grouped product.

parent_id.description: ID of the variable product of a variation, or 0.

attributes.description: Attributes with their options on a product, or the option each attribute picks on a variation. For a global attribute the options are term slugs.

id.description: ID of the global attribute, or 0 for an attribute of this product only.

option.description: The option a variation picks. Omitted when the variation matches any option.

variation.description: Whether the variations pick an option of this attribute.

images.description: Featured image first, then the gallery.

weight.description: Decimal string in lbs, or empty when not set.

dimensions.description: Decimal strings in in, each empty when not set.

shipping_class.description: Shipping class slug, or empty when the product has none.

shipping_class_id.description: Shipping class term ID, or 0 when the product has none.

tax_class.description: Tax class slug, or empty for the standard rate.

low_stock_amount.description: Low stock threshold of the product. Omitted when the store-wide threshold applies.

variation_ids.description: IDs of the variations of a variable product.

date_created.description: Product creation date in the store timezone. Omitted when no creation date is available.

date_created_gmt.description: Product creation date in UTC. Omitted when no creation date is available.

date_modified.description: Product modification date in the store timezone. Omitted when no modification date is available.

date_modified_gmt.description: Product modification date in UTC. Omitted when no modification date is available.

variations.description: The variations the call created or changed, in input order. Deleted variations are not listed.

permalink.description: Product permalink. Omitted when no public permalink is available.
